video_title: Payton Pritchard on Jaylen Brown Trade, New Teammates, & More | Garden Report EXCLUSIVE Interview

quotes.speaker: Payton Pritchard
quotes.summary_phrase: Payton Pritchard on the trade of Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: It always sucks to see a brother and a teammate that you played with for a long time go.
quotes.quote: You just used to seeing big things and think changes happen all the time. It always sucks to see a brother and a teammate that you played with for a long time go, but you move on and you are ready to go to war.

quotes.speaker: Payton Pritchard
quotes.summary_phrase: Payton Pritchard ranks his golf skills against teammates
quotes.excerpt: Sam is probably first. Me and Mike have been having some battles.
quotes.quote: Sam is probably first. Me and Mike have been having some battles. We played a little bit in LA, so we had some battles, but Mike is better than I am. We are two and one in our matches, so he is one, two, I have one, but I would say I am third.

quotes.speaker: Payton Pritchard
quotes.summary_phrase: Payton Pritchard on the addition of Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: The things we need, the rebounding, the toughness inside, he is going to bring it.
quotes.quote: I was his roommate when I was in college one time for USA. I think he is going to be great for us. The things we need, the rebounding, the toughness inside, he is going to bring it. Just adding to that big depth that we already have with Neemias and Luka, and then obviously Mitchell now, it is just going to be really good in that area.

quotes.speaker: Payton Pritchard
quotes.summary_phrase: Payton Pritchard on the Celtics' playoff loss to the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: You just can't let a team feel comfortable in a Game 5.
quotes.quote: You just can't let a team feel comfortable in a Game 5. We had them on the hills. I felt like they didn't really want to win that game, and we let them back in it and they got confident. Then you go back on the road, they win that, and then Game 7 is just a toss-up game. It was definitely a disappointing finish. I thought we had a great regular season, but there is things we got to tighten up and be better for the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Payton Pritchard
quotes.summary_phrase: Payton Pritchard's goals for improving his game
quotes.excerpt: Maybe getting better at how to draw fouls now, not being a flopper but drawing fouls.
quotes.quote: Maybe getting better at how to draw fouls now, not being a flopper but drawing fouls and getting to the free throw line more. I think I need to get better at that. It is technique stuff, learning when to draw the foul when they are being handsy. I have been working on it, and just adding to little footwork stuff and becoming even more efficient in that area, being a better finisher.

quotes.speaker: Payton Pritchard
quotes.summary_phrase: Payton Pritchard on the team's identity for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: Playing really hard and making smart reads and decisions.
quotes.quote: Playing really hard and making smart reads and decisions, that is the biggest thing. We need everybody to take a step. Regular season wins, you win by playing hard, and then playoffs, you win by playing harder and smarter.

quotes.speaker: Payton Pritchard
quotes.summary_phrase: Payton Pritchard on Jayson Tatum's recovery
quotes.excerpt: I definitely expect him to be even stronger and more explosive.
quotes.quote: He came back after the nine months, so I definitely expect him to be even stronger and more explosive.
